aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Return + RTO Financial Summary
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  COALESCE(order_status, 'Unknown') AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS reversed_gmv,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_base,
  SUM(total_tax) AS gst_reversed,
  SUM(tcs_taxable_amount) AS tcs_base_reversed,
  AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC;
